changeSet.author: medcollect
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE mc_sync_origin ( remote_id VARCHAR2(80) PRIMARY KEY, knowledge_id VARCHAR2(36) NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES mc_knowledge(id), created_at NUMBER(19) NOT NULL )

changeSet.author: medcollect
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO mc_sync_origin (remote_id, knowledge_id, created_at) SELECT remote_id, MIN(knowledge_id), MIN(created_at) FROM ( SELECT k.remote_id, k.id knowledge_id, e.occurred_at created_at FROM mc_knowledge k JOIN mc_event e ON e.entity_type = 'KNOWLEDGE' AND e.entity_id = k.id WHERE e.action = 'SYNC_CREATED' AND e.note = k.remote_id UNION ALL SELECT v.remote_id, v.knowledge_id, v.synced_at FROM mc_sync_version v JOIN mc_knowledge k ON k.id = v.knowledge_id AND k.remote_id = v.remote_id WHERE v.operation = 'CREATE' AND k.status = 'SYNCED' ) receipts GROUP BY remote_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT knowledge_id) = 1
